title: China reverse engineering downed craft

tellings.quote: we know for a fact they are working on reverse engineering they have down craft

plain: On Jesse Michels' podcast, a guest named Bob Maguire, in an episode billed as being with a CIA contractor (the CIA is the US foreign intelligence agency), says that China has crashed or downed craft of unknown origin. He says 'we know for a fact' that China is trying to reverse engineer them, meaning take them apart to learn how they work, which would mean a race between nations for such technology.
